title: Facebook Ads for Pet Grooming: Examples & Strategy | GetHookd

facts.fact: GetHookd's page recommends setting a 10–20-mile targeting radius around the groomer's salon for Facebook ads.
facts.quote: set a 10–20-mile radius around your salon, layer in breed and pet-owner interests

facts.fact: GetHookd's page recommends filming a pet grooming time-lapse transformation video of 15–30 seconds.
facts.quote: Shoot a 15–30 second clip that condenses an entire grooming session

facts.fact: GetHookd's page recommends filming time-lapse grooming footage at 4x or 8x speed.
facts.quote: Film at 4x or 8x speed, add upbeat royalty-free music
